title: T1591 — Gather Victim Org Information
subtitle: The animation at the top of this section plays the whole story of T1591 in eight steps.
aria: Animated diagram of the attack story step by step. A written version of every step follows below this animation.

nodes.label: Sensitive data
nodes.tip: Sensitive data - What is at risk

steps.title: Pick the target
steps.caption: The attacker chooses a company and starts reading everything public about it.
steps.defender: Recon happens outside your network. Your first job is knowing what is public.

fields.detail: The attacker chooses a company and starts reading everything public about it.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Scrape organization pages
steps.caption: The attacker quickly copies the About, Leadership, and Locations pages.
steps.defender: CDN and WAF logs can show one source pulling many org-info pages.

fields.detail: The attacker quickly copies the About, Leadership, and Locations pages.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Mine professional networks
steps.caption: The attacker lists employees, their titles, and who reports to whom.
steps.defender: Some employees will receive strange recruiter messages. Reward reporting.

fields.detail: The attacker lists employees, their titles, and who reports to whom.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Probe disclosure channels
steps.caption: The attacker asks innocent-looking questions in public support spaces.
steps.defender: Repeated similar questions from one source are a classic elicitation pattern.

fields.detail: The attacker asks innocent-looking questions in public support spaces.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Assemble the org map
steps.caption: The attacker joins all facts into one profile of the company and its people.
steps.defender: Nothing reaches you at this step. The profile now exists outside your network.

fields.detail: The attacker joins all facts into one profile of the company and its people.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Clone the brand
steps.caption: The attacker copies logos and text onto a staging site with a look-alike domain.
steps.defender: Brand monitoring and CT log watching can reveal the new domain early.

fields.detail: The attacker copies logos and text onto a staging site with a look-alike domain.

detection.label: Partial signal
detection.detail: A weak signal exists but is not yet a confirmed alert.

steps.title: Prepare the approach
steps.caption: The attacker links the profile to a phishing plan: who, how, and when.
steps.defender: Watch for the hand-off to phishing (T1566) in mail gateway logs.

fields.detail: The attacker links the profile to a phishing plan: who, how, and when.

detection.label: Alert raised
detection.detail: The SOC has enough evidence to open an incident.

steps.title: Hand-off to initial access
steps.caption: The finished profile is handed to the access phase. The guide on T1566 continues from here.
steps.defender: From now on your own network and mail detections take over. Report and correlate.

fields.detail: The finished profile is handed to the access phase. The guide on T1566 continues from here.

detection.label: Contained
detection.detail: The activity is contained and the lesson is captured.
